name: 64151 · Kansas City, MO
findings: ZIP 64151 (Kansas City) has 73 nonprofit organizations. 37 of them (51%) list at least one way to get involved on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 28 organizations.
Religious organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (12% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 64151 (Kansas City) has about as many organizations offering opportunities per resident.
35% of the organizations offering opportunities have no identified type, so the breakdown by type is partial.

observations.title: Fewer organizations list membership
observations.text: Per resident, fewer organizations in ZIP 64151 (Kansas City) list membership on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 71% of the typical level).

confidence.text: Based on 39 organizations here; 49% of all organizations here have no identified type.
